|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">Ｃ－３ＰＯのいる位置で、Ｃ－３ＰＯを含むドロイドと反乱軍のペアが一つ組めるごとに合計戦闘力＋２。同じ位置にいるＲ２－Ｄ２の没収値に＋２。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-c-3po-see-threepio-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">サイボット・ギャラクティカ社の３ＰＯは、人間と機械の通訳を務めるドロイドである。６００万種以上の言語に通じ、作動から１１２年が経過。一度もメモリ消去を受けたことがない…ただし、覚えている限りでの話だが。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' C-3PO (See-Threepio).

'''Card text:''' At [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]]'s site, add 2 to total power for each pair consisting of a droid, including [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]], and a Rebel. [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)|R2-D2]] is forfeit +2 at the same site.

'''Lore:''' Cybot Galactica's 3PO is a droid that interprets between humans and machines. It knows more than six million languages and has been operating for 112 years. It has never had its memory erased, at least as far as it can remember.
